title: Great Item, Needs Checked Before Sent
text: Great Item, Needs Checked Before Sent. These are beautiful curtains and do a great job at room darkening and keeping the chill out (we have drafty windows). I thought they would be more cotton based, but they are silk in texture and have a silver backing. They feel really nice! My biggest complaint is that they came with some snags and dangling threads. We were in a hurry to get the nursery together, but probably would have returned otherwise to receive new ones.
